description: Implementation of a simple ring buffer API with functions for claiming, finishing, putting, getting, and peeking data, as well as handling ring buffer items with headers.

methods.name: ring_buf_put_claim
methods.description: Claims space in the ring buffer for writing data, adjusting for wrap-around.

methods.name: ring_buf_put_finish
methods.description: Finalizes a put operation by updating buffer pointers after data has been written.

methods.name: ring_buf_put
methods.description: Copies data into the ring buffer, handling multiple partial writes.

methods.name: ring_buf_get_claim
methods.description: Claims data from the ring buffer for reading, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: ring_buf_get_finish
methods.description: Finalizes a get operation by updating buffer pointers after data has been read.

methods.name: ring_buf_get
methods.description: Reads data from the ring buffer, handling multiple partial reads.

methods.name: ring_buf_peek
methods.description: Reads data from the ring buffer without removing it, then unclaims the data.

methods.name: ring_buf_item_put
methods.description: Stores an item with a header and data into the ring buffer.

methods.name: ring_buf_item_get
methods.description: Retrieves an item with a header and data from the ring buffer.
